body:
Hi Val,
Thank you for this. I agree, so I removed the term from those entries and added [GO:0000398](http://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGo/GTerm?id=GO:0000398) to IPR034100, IPR034098 and [GO:0000395](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO:0000395) and [GO:0030627](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO:0030627) to IPR017340.
The changes will be available in the next InterPro release.
Best,
Beatriz
